title: 第2章：粮票，手机所带来的冲击
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
事实就是，王素琴一直视这段婚姻为耻辱，当年她是为了口粮，才不得已嫁给乡下泥腿子，也就是马超的父亲马建业。

    等到恢复高考，以及全国知青返城，王素琴做的第一件事就是和马建业离婚，和这个她看不起的泥腿子撇清关系。

    况且是和这个男人生下的马超。

    想起这些往事，马超嘴角泛起一丝苦涩，“苏姐姐，我没钱。”

    “姐姐请你吃，不用你花钱。”

    没有对比就没有伤害。

    养家的担子落在马超肩上的时候他没哭，被继父家孩子敲闷棍他也没哭，此刻听见苏雨琪真挚的话语，马超鼻子却泛起一阵酸涩。

    “谢谢你，苏姐姐。”

    苏雨琪莞尔一笑，“我还要谢谢你呢。”

    其实只有苏雨琪心里清楚，这要换成其他不讲理的人，光是去医院检查就是一大笔费用，这对于一个准大学生来说，无疑是天塌了。

    说起来她才是占便宜的那个。

    ……

    没几分钟。

    两人来到一个卖包子的早餐铺。

    可能是已经过了早高峰的原因，门庭若市的包子铺前，此时门可罗雀，显然已经不剩多少了。

    苏雨琪一看还真是，不由黛眉微蹙道，“马超，就剩下鲜肉包子了。”

    “要是你不喜欢吃包子的话，我带你到前面去吃牛肉面怎么样？”

    “不用了苏姐姐，我吃一个包子就可以了。”

    苏雨琪没理他，坚持将剩余的包子全部打包，一共12个包子，老板按10个包子收的钱，一个1.5元，总共15元。

    雪白的包子，香气扑鼻，让人忍不住流口水。

    然而！

    接下来的一幕，仿佛刷新了马超的三观。

    苏雨琪拿出一个铁盒子在空中晃了一下，“老板，钱扫过去了，谢谢老板。”

    “不客气，下次再来。”

    “好！”

    苏雨琪回了个甜甜微笑，对着马超道：“咱们走吧，还想吃点啥，姐姐给你买。”
content_en:
The fact is that Wang Suqin has always regarded this marriage as a shame. She had no choice but to marry a country man, Ma Chao's father Ma Jianye, just for food rations.

    When the college entrance examination resumed and the educated youth from all over the country returned to the city, the first thing Wang Suqin did was to divorce Ma Jianye and distance herself from this mud-legged person she looked down on.

    Besides, it was Ma Chao who was born to this man.

    Thinking of these past events, Ma Chao's mouth turned bitter, "Sister Su, I have no money."

    "Sister, I'll treat you to a meal at no cost to you."

    There is no harm without contrast.

    He didn't cry when the burden of supporting the family fell on Ma Chao's shoulders, and he didn't cry when his stepfather's children knocked him down. At this moment, hearing Su Yuqi's sincere words, Ma Chao's nose felt sour.

    "Thank you, Sister Su."

    Su Yuqi smiled and said, "I still want to thank you."

    In fact, only Su Yuqi knew in her heart that if it were other unreasonable people, just going to the hospital for examination would be a huge expense, which would undoubtedly be a huge expense for a prospective college student.

    Speaking of which, she was the one who took advantage.

    …

    Not a few minutes.

    The two of them came to a breakfast shop selling steamed buns.

    Perhaps it was because the morning rush hour had passed, but the busy steamed bun shop was deserted at this time, and there were obviously not many left.

    When Su Yuqi saw that it was true, she couldn't help but frown slightly and said, "Ma Chao, all that's left is the fresh meat buns."

    "If you don't like steamed buns, how about I take you to the front to eat beef noodles?"

    "No need, Sister Su, I'll just eat a steamed bun."

    Su Yuqi ignored him and insisted on packing all the remaining buns, a total of 12 buns. The boss charged 1.5 yuan for 10 buns, a total of 15 yuan.

    The snow-white buns are fragrant and make people drool.

    However!

    The next scene seemed to refresh Ma Chao's outlook on life.

    Su Yuqi took out an iron box and shook it in the air. "Boss, the money has been swept over. Thank you, boss."

    "You're welcome, come back next time."

    "Okay!"

    Su Yuqi smiled sweetly and said to Ma Chao: "Let's go. If you want to eat something else, sister will buy it for you."
title_en: Chapter 2: The impact of food stamps and mobile phones
